deviation: Payment terms are 20 days, shorter than the 30-day floor the playbook says never to accept (standard is 45). Late interest is at the maximum legal rate rather than capped at 1% per month, and annual advance invoicing (USD 480,000) is within the one-quarter limit only if... it is not: it is a full year in advance, which breaches the playbook's "never beyond one quarter" limit.
suggested_text: 4.2 The Supplier shall invoice the Fees quarterly in advance. The Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within forty-five (45) days of receipt of a valid invoice. 4.4 Late payments of undisputed amounts shall accrue interest at a rate not exceeding one percent (1%) per month from the due date until payment in full, and the Supplier may suspend the Services in accordance with Section 2.4 only after thirty (30) days' written notice of non-payment of undisputed amounts.
